_note: Central and state public authorities. Each entry carries a level of central or state. Officer titles and designations, never names. Under section 5(1) every central public authority designates Central Public Information Officers, so the designation is the same across these entries. What differs, and what actually decides whether an application reaches the right desk, is which office holds the records. That is what officerNote records. The government directory of PIOs is at rti.gov.in. Nothing here is a substitute for checking it.
sourceLabel: RTI Act 2005, section 5(1); RTI Portal Gateway officer directory

authorities.name: Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare
authorities.ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
authorities.officerNote: The department designates its own CPIO, but an individual pension file usually sits with the pensioner's last employing department or its Pay and Accounts Office, each of which has a separate CPIO.
authorities.records: Pension sanction files, Pension Payment Order records, family pension case files, revision orders and grievance records.
authorities.siteLabel: Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare RTI

authorities.name: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation
authorities.officerNote: EPFO designates a CPIO in each regional and zonal office. Apply to the office that holds the member account, not to head office.
authorities.records: Member and UAN service records, provident fund claim files, transfer and withdrawal records, pension and insurance claim files.

authorities.name: Employees' State Insurance Corporation
authorities.officerNote: CPIOs are designated at regional and sub-regional offices. The office covering the insured person's employer holds the file.
authorities.records: Insured person registration records, employer contribution records, benefit and reimbursement claim files, records held by ESIC dispensaries and hospitals.

authorities.name: Central Board of Direct Taxes
authorities.officerNote: CPIOs are designated across field formations. The charge of the assessing officer holds the case record, so name the assessment year and jurisdiction.
authorities.records: Assessment records, refund processing and adjustment records, PAN allotment records, rectification and appeal effect orders.

authorities.name: Ministry of Railways
authorities.officerNote: CPIOs are designated for the Railway Board and separately for each zonal railway and division. A ticketing matter belongs to the zone that issued or cancelled the ticket.
authorities.records: Ticket refund and Ticket Deposit Receipt files, reservation and cancellation records, complaint and enquiry records, tender and contract records.

authorities.name: Unique Identification Authority of India
authorities.ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
authorities.officerNote: UIDAI designates a CPIO at headquarters and at each regional office. The regional office covering the enrolment centre holds the record.
authorities.records: Enrolment and update request records, correspondence on rejected updates, and process records. Authentication and biometric data are subject to statutory exemptions.

authorities.name: Ministry of External Affairs
authorities.officerNote: Each Regional Passport Office has its own CPIO. Apply to the office processing the application, quoting the file number.
authorities.records: Passport application files, police verification reports received from the state police, printing and dispatch records, and records of objections raised.

authorities.name: The public sector bank concerned
authorities.ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Financial Services
authorities.officerNote: Each public sector bank designates its own CPIO, usually at head office with further CPIOs at zonal offices. A private bank is not a public authority and cannot be asked under this Act.
authorities.records: Account and transaction records of the applicant, loan sanction and rejection files, customer grievance correspondence, and branch level policy circulars.

authorities.name: The central university or institution concerned
authorities.officerNote: Each central university designates its own CPIO, in most cases in the Registrar's office. A state university is a state public authority and goes through the state route.
authorities.records: Evaluated answer sheets and evaluation records, admission and eligibility files, result and revaluation records, degree and migration records.

authorities.name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
authorities.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
authorities.officerNote: The sanctioning ministry holds the disbursement record, but verification of an application is done by the state department and the institution, each of which has its own PIO.
authorities.records: Scholarship application records on the National Scholarship Portal, institute and state verification records, sanction and disbursement records, and rejection reasons.
authorities.siteLabel: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment RTI

authorities.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
authorities.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
authorities.officerNote: The ministry has its own CPIO, and each central institution such as AIIMS designates a separate CPIO. Treatment records belong to the hospital, not the ministry.
authorities.records: Scheme administration records including Ayushman Bharat and PM-JAY, empanelment and claim records, and administrative records of central government hospitals.
authorities.siteLabel: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare RTI

authorities.name: The municipal corporation or council concerned
authorities.officerNote: Every municipal corporation and council designates its own SPIO, usually in the commissioner's office. A ward office may hold the day to day record.
authorities.records: Ward works and expenditure records, building plan approvals, property tax records, birth and death registration records, sanitation and water complaints.

authorities.name: The state police concerned
authorities.officerNote: SPIOs are designated at the district superintendent's office and at commissionerates. The station holding the case papers is the one to name.
authorities.records: First Information Report copies, case diaries subject to exemptions, station records, complaint receipts and action taken reports.

authorities.name: The state transport authority concerned
authorities.officerNote: SPIOs are designated at the regional transport office. Apply to the office that holds the licence or permit record.
authorities.records: Driving licence and learner records, vehicle registration files, permit and fitness records, challan and penalty records.

authorities.name: The revenue and land records office concerned
authorities.officerNote: SPIOs are designated at the tehsil or taluk office. Mutation and survey records sit with the local revenue office, not the state headquarters.
authorities.records: Record of rights, mutation entries, survey and settlement records, encumbrance records and land acquisition files.

authorities.name: The state treasury or pension office concerned
authorities.officerNote: SPIOs are designated at the district treasury. A state pension file usually sits with the treasury that issues the payment.
authorities.records: State pension sanction and payment records, gratuity and commutation files, treasury bill records and arrears calculations.

authorities.name: The state education department concerned
authorities.officerNote: SPIOs are designated at the directorate and at district education offices. A school record sits with the district office, not the directorate.
authorities.records: School recognition and admission records, scholarship disbursement records, examination and result records, teacher appointment records.

authorities.name: The state electricity board or distribution company concerned
authorities.officerNote: SPIOs are designated at the divisional or subdivisional office. The office serving the connection holds the record.
authorities.records: Connection and meter records, billing and metering disputes, load sanction files, outage and fault records.

authorities.name: The water supply and sewerage board concerned
authorities.officerNote: SPIOs are designated at the divisional office of the board or at the municipal body where water supply sits with the corporation.
authorities.records: Connection records, billing records, supply schedules, pipeline and sewerage works records and complaint registers.

authorities.name: The office of the District Collector or District Magistrate
authorities.officerNote: The collectorate designates its own SPIO. Many district level schemes and certificates are held here rather than at the state headquarters.
authorities.records: Certificates such as income, caste and residence, relief and compensation files, district scheme records and land acquisition records.

authorities.name: Not identified
authorities.officerNote: Look the authority up in your state's own RTI portal or the directory at rti.gov.in before filing. State bodies are not listed on the central portal.

authorities.name: Not identified
authorities.officerNote: Look the authority up in the government directory at rti.gov.in before filing. An application sent to the wrong authority should be transferred within five days under section 6(3), but that transfer is not guaranteed and it costs you time.

_linkNote: siteUrl points at the body's own RTI or transparency page where one could be verified, and at the RTI Portal Gateway where it could not. Every URL was checked to return 200.
_stateNote: State entries are generic role descriptions of the body a citizen deals with, never a named office holder and never a specific named institution. Under section 5(1) a state public authority designates a State Public Information Officer. State bodies are not on the central portal, so these carry the RTI Portal Gateway link rather than a filing link.
